mapper.select: select notification_id, user_id, notification_type, business_type, business_id, title, content, target_path, read_flag, dedupe_key, read_time, create_time from pm_user_notification where user_id = #{userId} and read_flag = #{readFlag} order by read_flag, create_time desc, notification_id desc limit 200
select count(*) from pm_user_notification where user_id = #{userId} and read_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert ignore into pm_user_notification( user_id, notification_type, business_type, business_id, title, content, target_path, read_flag, dedupe_key, create_time ) values ( #{userId}, #{notificationType}, #{businessType}, #{businessId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{targetPath}, #{readFlag}, #{dedupeKey}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update pm_user_notification set read_flag = '1', read_time = coalesce(read_time, sysdate()) where user_id = #{userId} and read_flag = '0'
mapper.sql:
select concat('APPROVAL:', t.task_id) item_key, 'APPROVAL' item_type, i.title title, concat(t.node_name, ' · 发起人：', coalesce(u.nick_name, u.user_name, '-')) description, t.status status, null due_date, concat('/projectManagement/workflow/task/', t.task_id) target_path, t.create_time create_time, 1 sort_group from pm_workflow_task_candidate c join pm_workflow_task t on t.task_id = c.task_id join pm_workflow_instance i on i.instance_id = t.instance_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = i.initiator_user_id where c.user_id = #{userId} and t.status = 'PENDING'
union all
select concat('TASK:', t.task_id), 'TASK', t.task_name, concat(p.project_name, ' · ', w.wbs_name), t.status, t.plan_end_date, concat('/personal/my-task?projectId=', t.project_id), t.create_time, 2 from pm_project_task t join pm_project p on p.project_id = t.project_id join pm_project_wbs_node w on w.wbs_id = t.work_package_id where t.assignee_user_id = #{userId} and t.task_type = 'EXECUTION' and t.status <> 'COMPLETED' and p.status = 'ACTIVE'
union all
select concat('DELIVERABLE:', d.deliverable_id), 'DELIVERABLE', d.deliverable_name, concat(p.project_name, ' · ', w.wbs_name), d.status, d.planned_date, '/personal/my-deliverable', d.create_time, 3 from pm_project_deliverable d join pm_project p on p.project_id = d.project_id join pm_project_wbs_node w on w.wbs_id = d.work_package_id where w.owner_user_id = #{userId} and d.status in ('PENDING', 'RETURNED') and p.status = 'ACTIVE'
union all
select concat('ISSUE:', issue.issue_id), 'ISSUE', issue.issue_name, concat(p.project_name, ' · ', issue.issue_code), issue.status, issue.due_date, concat('/projectManagement/execution/issue?projectId=', issue.project_id), issue.create_time, 4 from pm_project_issue issue join pm_project p on p.project_id = issue.project_id where issue.owner_user_id = #{userId} and issue.status in ('OPEN', 'PROCESSING') and p.status in ('APPROVED', 'ACTIVE', 'PAUSED')
mapper.select: select item_key, item_type, title, description, status, due_date, target_path, create_time from () todo order by sort_group, case when due_date is null then 1 else 0 end, due_date, create_time desc limit 300

select t.assignee_user_id user_id, count(*) task_count, min(t.plan_start_date) first_start_date, max(t.plan_end_date) last_end_date from pm_project_task t where t.project_id = #{projectId} and t.task_type = 'EXECUTION' and t.assignee_user_id is not null group by t.assignee_user_id
